covers: The Yamaha YM2151 (OPM) FM synthesizer as a chip

left_out.why: the OPP, same register layout as the ym2151 and listed in its types; MAME declares its extra registers 0x00 to 0x07 and half-speed timer B in a comment and implements neither

entries.name: YM2151 OPM
entries.description: Yamaha four-operator FM synthesizer with eight stereo channels, an LFO, a noise source and two timers, programmed through an address port and a data port.
entries.behaviour: Offset 0 selects a register and offset 1 writes it; registers cannot be read back. A read of offset 1 returns status (bit 0 timer A, bit 1 timer B, bit 7 busy for 64 chip clocks after a data write) and offset 0 reads 0xFF. While the reset line is low writes are ignored; raising it resets the chip.

handlers.write: address on offset 0, data on offset 1
